recent_articles.title: TDP leverages technology in organising hybrid Mahanadu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Telugu Desam Party (TDP)** held its virtual Mahanadu 2026, a hybrid event with over seven lakh cadres participating. The two-day conclave featured a timer for speeches and utilized technology to manage the organization. **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** delivered his presidential message to participants across the state, utilizing a GPS-enabled digital invitation system and a central command-and-control center.  The event aimed to be cost-efficient and inclusive by leveraging technology.

recent_articles.title: Raichur MP raises concern over proposed Information Technology Act amendments - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **G. Kumar Naik**, a member of the **Parliamentary Standing Committee on Communication and Information Technology**, has urged **Ashwini Vaishnaw**, Union Minister for Electronics and Information Technology, to reconsider certain provisions in the draft Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Second Amendment Rules 2026.  **Naik** expressed concerns that the proposed amendments could impact democratic participation, free expression, and Constitutional safeguards by expanding the scope of Part III of the rules and enabling direct Ministry referrals to an Inter-Departmental Committee without a complaint from an aggrieved party. He also raised objections to linking intermediary safe harbor protections under Section 79 of the Information Technology Act 2000 to compliance with government advisories, clarifications, and standard operating procedures.  **Naik** emphasized the importance of balancing platform accountability and online safety with Constitutional guarantees of free expression and independent oversight in India's evolving digital governance framework.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet approves four more judges for Supreme Court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union Cabinet** approved an increase in the number of Supreme Court judges from 34 to 38, a move aimed at addressing the ongoing backlog of cases.  The amendment will be introduced in Parliament and requires approval from the **Parliament**. The current backlog stands at 92,385 cases, with several judges scheduled to retire this year. This decision follows a six-year hiatus since the last increase in 2019.

recent_articles.title: Renowned lyricist Prasoon Joshi appointed Prasar Bharati Chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prasoon Joshi**, a renowned lyricist and writer, has been appointed Chairman of **Prasar Bharati** by the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**.  Mr. Vaishnaw expressed confidence in Mr. Joshi's ability to lead Prasar Bharati through technological transformation and evolving audience expectations. Mr. Joshi previously served as Chairperson of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) and holds various other prominent positions within the creative industries.

recent_articles.title: Telangana IT Minister for stronger digital push in govt. schools - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D. Sridhar Babu**, Minister for IT and Industries, visited a 'Super Summer Camp' in Manthani town to support the development of digital infrastructure in government schools. The camp, organized by **T-Fiber** and **Super Teacher Edu Reforms Pvt. Ltd.** aims to bridge the digital divide and provide hands-on learning experiences in computer education, AI, and robotics for students. Similar camps will be held in Peddapalli, Ramagundam, and Sulthanabad until May 23rd with a closing ceremony scheduled for May 26th.

recent_articles.title: Railways Minister flags off first Jammu-Srinagar direct train service on ‘historic day’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Minister for Railways Ashwini Vaishnaw** and **J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah** celebrated the launch of the first direct train service between Jammu city and Srinagar city.  Vaishnaw described the service as a "gamechanger" for the region's economy, highlighting its impact on cargo movement and tourism. The new rail line connects the Kashmir division with the Jammu division, offering seamless travel to pilgrimage destinations like Shree Mata Vaishno Devi and Shri Amarnath temple. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** is credited with realizing the dream of railway connectivity in the Kashmir Valley.

recent_articles.title: Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation for Google’s ₹1.35 lakh crore AI data centre in Visakhapatnam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** laid the foundation stone for a 1-Gigawatt Google data center in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam, marking one of India's largest foreign direct investments. The project will be managed by **Google’s subsidiary Raiden Infotech**, in partnership with **Adani Infra**, and is part of a $15 billion investment from **Google** in the state.  The center will offer large-scale data storage and AI cloud infrastructure, and an upcoming subsea cable system will connect Visakhapatnam to several countries. Union Ministers, IT Minister Nara Lokesh, and representatives from Google, Adani Group, and Airtel Nxtra attended the ceremony.

recent_articles.title: Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation for Google’s ₹1.35 lakh crore AI data centre in Visakhapatnam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: On Tuesday, April 28, 2026, **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** laid the foundation stone for a Google data center in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam. The $15 billion investment will create a 1-Gigawatt hyperscale AI data center on 601.4 acres and is expected to generate thousands of jobs. **Union Ministers Ashwini Vaishnaw**, **Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu**, and **Pemmasani Chandrasekhar**, along with **IT Minister Nara Lokesh** and representatives from Google, Adani Infra, and other partners attended the ceremony.  The project will be inaugurated in September 2028 and is expected to position Andhra Pradesh as an international data gateway for India.

recent_articles.title: Children with Special Needs from State-run schools in Andhra Pradesh scale Everest Base Camp, set national benchmark - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Twenty-one children with special needs** from government schools in Andhra Pradesh successfully completed the Everest Base Camp trek in Nepal. The 16-day expedition, organized by **Samagra Shiksha**, Andhra Pradesh, and supported by the School Education Department, marked the first government-sponsored Everest Base Camp trek for specially-abled students.  The students, accompanied by mountaineers and officials, demonstrated their determination to overcome social stigma and achieve their goals. **Nara Lokesh**, HRD Minister and IT Minister of Andhra Pradesh, congratulated the students on their success and highlighted the importance of inclusivity in education.

recent_articles.title: Telangana IT Minister Sridhar Babu calls for stricter curbs against gutka, pan masala, khaini and drugs in State - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Duddilla Sridhar Babu**, **Telangana IT Minister**, warned against the consumption of gutka, pan masala, khaini, and narcotics, emphasizing their serious health risks. He urged young people to avoid addiction and adopt healthier lifestyles during an Oral Cancer Awareness Marathon in Hyderabad organized by the **Global Oral Cancer Trust**.  **Cyberabad Police Commissioner M. Ramesh** also participated in the event, flagging off a 5K run.

recent_articles.title: Lokesh inaugurates cricket stadium built at ₹10-cr. cost in Tirupati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nara Lokesh**, the Human Resource Development and IT Minister, inaugurated two new sports facilities in Tirupati district. The **Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao cricket stadium** and **Nara Ramamurthy Naidu Kreeda Vikasa Kendram** were built at a combined cost of ₹13.27 crore and aim to enhance sports infrastructure in the region. Lokesh announced a 90-day action plan to prioritize sports development, including creating fitness facilities for school children and utilizing existing sports quota jobs to improve the sector. He also met with several prominent athletes from various disciplines.

recent_articles.title: Bengaluru–Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper train gets approval - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** has approved the introduction of a **Vande Bharat sleeper train service** between KSR Bengaluru and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus in Mumbai. The **South Western Railway (SWR)** will run and maintain the semi-high-speed train, which is expected to enhance overnight travel between the two cities. This will be the second Vande Bharat sleeper train in India, following the first service launched in January 2026 between Howrah and Kamakhya.

recent_articles.title: KTR showcases Telangana growth model at Columbia Business School - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K.T. Rama Rao**, working president of the **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)**, lauded **Telangana’s** rapid economic and technological transformation during a speech at the 21st Annual India Business Conference in New York.  He emphasized that the state's success was due to its clear leadership under **K. Chandrasekhar Rao**, highlighting Telangana's growth in IT exports, employment in the technology sector, and investment in innovation infrastructure. He also pointed out the state's contributions to life sciences, including vaccine production and biotech innovation.

recent_articles.title: Kerala’s wait for high-speed rail to linger on - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite election promises from various political fronts in Kerala, the **Union government** has no immediate plans for a high-speed rail project.  The **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** manifesto proposes a green high-speed railway network connecting Thiruvananthapuram to Kannur, while the **Left Democratic Front (LDF)** and **United Democratic Alliance (UDF)** have pledged continued efforts towards a north-south route. The **Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** stated that the focus will be on enhancing existing rail networks' speed potential through additional lines.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka Minister M.B. Patil writes to Centre seeking express train between Bengaluru and Vijayapura - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka's Infrastructure Development Minister M.B. Patil** has requested **Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** and **Minister of State for Railways V. Somanna** to introduce a long-pending express train service between Bengaluru and Vijayapura, citing the completion of the Almatti–Wandal double line railway section.  Patil's request follows an earlier meeting where it was suggested that once the project is finished, an express train could be introduced. He also asked for trains from Bengaluru to Vijayapura to have limited stops up to Hubballi and to be routed via the Hubballi and Gadag bypass line to reduce travel time.
